title: [BUG] Theme should not be changed on `Esc`
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.43
- Operating System: linux, windows-terminal, v1.0.41 (win10 wsl ubuntu 24)
- Terminal:  modern windows terminal

## Bug Description
Lets say your current theme is Dark.
You can move (select to preview) to another theme to see how it looks.
Now you can cancel theme changing on `Esc`.
And the config theme's menu immediately says that discarded theme is now your current theme.

## Steps to Reproduce
See `Bug Description`.

## Expected Behavior
The current theme should not be changed on `Esc` in theme preview.

## Actual Behavior
See `Bug Description`.
